shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && nl -ba src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '1,180p' && sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml && rg -n \"new Date\\(|fake timers|setSystemTime\" src/orchestration --glob '*.test.ts' | head -80"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts .lore/dod.md && if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; fi && git diff --check && git diff -- src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts .lore/dod.md specs'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"onErrorNonError\\.acceptance\\.test\\.ts\" specs .lore CHANGELOG.md && nl -ba src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '48,70p' && git status --short"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "Make onError acceptance fixture deterministic" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git status --short --branch'
